shortlist.purpose: Candidates for targeted physical-contact validation only. They are NOT qualified CCDA pairs and must not be sent directly to formal Gate 4 solely because of this ranking.

scientific.next_action: Do not send contact-proxy-only pairs directly to formal Gate 4. Use the margin-ranked shortlist for a small targeted replay that first checks whether a genuine simulator-native DLO-post contact/coupling signal can be obtained from the pinned DLO-Lab implementation at the candidate timestep. Only physically confirmed hidden-state differences should proceed to snapshot same-action branching. If a stable physical contact readout cannot be obtained, do not promote the 3 mm proxy to ground truth; move to a published task with a cleaner privileged interaction state.
non_claims: The binary 3 mm contact-like proxy is not physical contact ground truth.
A large proxy margin is not proof of physical contact.
A small proxy margin is not proof of physical equivalence.
The shortlist is ranked without future divergence or sensor signals.
No threshold from the deadband sweep is promoted to a new formal gate.
